content.text:
I changed the retry wait in `_retryAction` (`packages/playwright-core/src/server/dom.ts`) so it runs on the Playwright side instead of in the page. I couldn't build or run anything, so the change is untested.

Before, the wait was a `setTimeout` evaluated in the page's utility world. With JavaScript disabled that timer never fires, so the promise hung until garbage collection and Playwright then reported the element as removed. The wait is now `await progress.wait(timeout)`, which uses a Node-side timer that still respects the action timeout and abort.

I also removed the `error:notconnected` check after that wait. It only existed because the in-page evaluation could fail. If the element is detached, the next action attempt will report it, as it already does.
